title: colander UI schema
description: Base template for the UI document colander compiles (docs/documents.md#ui-schema). Uses only keywords from the subset colander itself implements (docs/json-schema.md, SPEC S-1..S-7), with local #/$defs references only, so this file also works when passed to colander_validate_schema.

schemaVersion.description: The UI document's own version; copied through by compile.

formSchemaVersion.description: The form version this UI was written against; copied through by compile.

fields.description: Keyed by field id. Entries are opaque to the core: only hidden is read, and non-object entries are tolerated and ignored.

anyOf.description: Any non-object value is tolerated and ignored.

uiField.description: Presentation of one field. Only hidden seeds evaluation (visibility[id] = false); label, widget and width are declared vocabulary but never read. Non-object entries are tolerated and ignored.

hidden.description: True seeds visibility[id] = false. A wrong-typed value is ignored.

label.description: Declared vocabulary, never read by the core.

widget.description: Declared vocabulary, never validated or interpreted, so any string passes through. Recognised names: text-input, textarea, number-input, integer-input, toggle, date-picker, datetime-picker, time-picker, select, group, repeater.

width.description: Declared vocabulary, never read by the core.

layoutNode.description: One presentation node. Unknown keys are dropped by compile, so only the kept keys are listed.

type.description: Required and non-empty; there is no enumeration of allowed node types.

fieldId.description: For type field: the field id. A node naming an expanded component reference becomes a group node with the component layout as children.
